name: Shamveel Khan
heroIntro: Software Developer | AI & Cybersecurity Enthusiast. CS Junior @ FAST-NUCES, based in Karachi, Pakistan.
biography: I'm Shamveel, a computer science junior at FAST-NUCES in Karachi, Pakistan. I build software and explore the intersection of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

My work spans full stack applications, machine learning, and hands-on security research. I enjoy turning an idea into something useful, understanding how a system works, and finding ways to make it more reliable and secure.
